sourceRefs.locator: ARTEM 4505, Archives nationales K 1 no. 7/1, regest and ll. 3–7. Abbot Dodo, the donor Dagobert, whose father was Baddo, and a plot described as within the walls of Paris.
IV.79, pp. 66–67, including n. 1. Illness at Épinay, Aega, Nanthild, Clovis and burial at Saint-Denis. Wallace-Hadrill follows Courtois in dating the death to 638.

summary.de: Der Frankenkönig und Vater Dagoberts I. bestätigte 625 Schenkungsgut für Saint-Denis. Der in jenem Dokument auftretende Schenker war ein Sohn Baddos.
summary.en: The Frankish king and father of Dagobert I confirmed a gift for Saint-Denis in 625. The donor named in that document was a son of Baddo.
